title: Taxat Object Lifecycle Atlas
subtitle: A governed storage river keeps upload source, quarantine, publication, delivery, and retention law explicit without turning raw storage into product truth.
basisStatement: Object classes keep staged bytes, quarantined bodies, retained evidence, customer-safe derivatives, and export bundles on explicit rails so raw storage location never becomes durable delivery truth.

stages.label: Stage
stages.summary: Receive or mint bytes under an explicit storage namespace and object class.

stages.label: Scan
stages.summary: Security and validation posture settle without implying delivery.

stages.label: Quarantine
stages.summary: Revocation or isolation stays explicit and history-preserving.

stages.label: Publish
stages.summary: Publication records durable source or derivative meaning before delivery.

stages.label: Deliver
stages.summary: Preview, download, or governed share require current delivery binding.

stages.label: Retain / Erase
stages.summary: Retention and erasure remain canonical control objects, not storage-only tags.

objectClasses.quarantineSummary: Malware or policy verdicts copy the upload source into quarantine and keep customer delivery unavailable.
objectClasses.deliverySummary: Delivery denied until a customer-safe derivative or explicit export bundle exists.
objectClasses.retentionSummary: Derived-artifact retention can expire earlier than retained source evidence while keeping erasure proof explicit.
notes: Upload source bytes remain resumable and non-previewable until scan, validation, and attachment confirmation settle.
No preview, download, or customer-safe target may be inferred from staging storage alone.

objectClasses.quarantineSummary: Quarantine is the primary posture for this class; release copies forward into a clean successor object.
objectClasses.deliverySummary: Preview and download remain route-bound, target-bound, and delivery-binding-bound.
objectClasses.retentionSummary: Regulated-record retention keeps legal hold, limitation, and erasure proof on canonical objects.
notes: Quarantine creates a new isolation boundary and preserves lineage in place.
False-positive release copies forward into a new clean object boundary rather than mutating quarantine in place.

stageCards.accessibleLabel: quarantine source preserved from prior upload lineage
stageCards.label: Stage
stageCards.summary: Quarantined bodies are already isolated artifacts, not resumable upload state.

stageCards.accessibleLabel: quarantine source awaits review evidence
stageCards.label: Scan
stageCards.summary: Security review and false-positive evidence can inspect lineage without reopening customer delivery.

stageCards.accessibleLabel: quarantine source never previewable or downloadable
stageCards.label: Quarantine
stageCards.summary: Quarantine is the dominant posture: no preview, no download, and no raw provider URLs.

stageCards.accessibleLabel: false positive release copies forward into clean successor
stageCards.label: Publish
stageCards.summary: Manual release creates a new clean object boundary instead of mutating the quarantined body in place.

stageCards.accessibleLabel: quarantine delivery stays revoked

stageCards.summary: Existing bindings are revoked and later delivery must happen on a clean successor object only.

stageCards.accessibleLabel: quarantine lineage retained for proof preservation
stageCards.label: Retain / Erase
stageCards.summary: Proof-preservation posture can hold the quarantined object even when the product object is replaced.

objectClasses.quarantineSummary: Late re-scan can revoke existing delivery and preserve quarantine lineage without rewriting durable source truth.
objectClasses.deliverySummary: Preview and download remain route-bound, target-bound, and delivery-binding-bound.
objectClasses.retentionSummary: Regulated-record retention keeps legal hold, limitation, and erasure proof on canonical objects.
notes: Retained evidence bodies remain durable internal truth and only become customer-visible through governed targets and delivery binding.
Current versus historical meaning remains explicit even when both objects share the retained-evidence namespace.

stageCards.accessibleLabel: retained evidence can be rescanned without changing durable ref

stageCards.accessibleLabel: retained evidence deliverable only through governed binding

notes: Customer-safe derivatives can be minted from internal-only sources without exposing the raw source body.
Derivative storage stays disposable while durable target and delivery refs remain stable.

stageCards.accessibleLabel: customer safe derivative minted from internal source
stageCards.label: Stage
stageCards.summary: A derivative is minted from an internal-only source instead of widening source-body access.

stageCards.accessibleLabel: customer safe derivative inherits clean source gate
stageCards.label: Scan
stageCards.summary: Derivative generation stays bound to the clean source and can be rebuilt if delivery context drifts.

stageCards.accessibleLabel: customer safe derivative quarantine revokes preview and download
stageCards.label: Quarantine
stageCards.summary: Derivative delivery can still be revoked later when scan or policy posture changes.

stageCards.accessibleLabel: customer safe derivative published for explicit current or history target
stageCards.label: Publish
stageCards.summary: Publishing keeps the derivative bound to explicit current-versus-history target semantics.

stageCards.accessibleLabel: customer safe derivative preview and download via governed binding
stageCards.label: Deliver
stageCards.summary: This is the customer-facing delivery class: preview and download remain route-bound and binding-bound.

stageCards.accessibleLabel: customer safe derivative retained or erased without rewriting source truth
stageCards.label: Retain / Erase
stageCards.summary: Retention acts on the derivative artifact while the source retained-evidence body keeps its own independent lineage.

objectClasses.quarantineSummary: Late re-scan can revoke existing delivery and preserve quarantine lineage without rewriting durable source truth.
objectClasses.deliverySummary: Download and governed share only. No ambient preview route is implied.
objectClasses.retentionSummary: Derived-artifact retention can expire earlier than retained source evidence while keeping erasure proof explicit.
notes: Masked export bundles are explicit derivative outputs rather than durable source truth.
Each export generation mints a new storage ref while the export invocation remains separately governed.

stageCards.accessibleLabel: masked export bundle minted on explicit export invocation
stageCards.label: Stage
stageCards.summary: Masked exports are explicit derivative bundles, not ambient side effects of viewing a document.

stageCards.accessibleLabel: masked export bundle rebuilds from current policy and source
stageCards.label: Scan
stageCards.summary: Each export generation can rebuild from current masking and retention policy without changing the source artifact.

stageCards.accessibleLabel: masked export quarantine revokes outward sharing
stageCards.label: Quarantine
stageCards.summary: If an export bundle becomes unsafe, the bundle is quarantined without rewriting source evidence.

stageCards.accessibleLabel: masked export published as explicit derivative output
stageCards.label: Publish
stageCards.summary: Publication records one export invocation with its own storage_ref and retention lineage.

stageCards.accessibleLabel: masked export download only through governed binding
stageCards.label: Deliver
stageCards.summary: Masked exports support download and governed sharing, not ambient preview.

stageCards.accessibleLabel: masked export erased once derivative retention window closes
stageCards.label: Retain / Erase
stageCards.summary: Derivative retention can end earlier than retained source evidence while still preserving erasure proof.

objectClasses.quarantineSummary: Late re-scan can revoke existing delivery and preserve quarantine lineage without rewriting durable source truth.
objectClasses.deliverySummary: Restricted delivery remains step-up and audit bound, and customer-safe sharing still requires a masked derivative.
objectClasses.retentionSummary: Regulated-record retention keeps legal hold, limitation, and erasure proof on canonical objects.
notes: Restricted export bundles stay outside customer-safe delivery and require separate visibility partitioning.
A masked export is a distinct derivative artifact, not a flag on the restricted bundle.

stageCards.accessibleLabel: restricted export bundle minted for step up review
stageCards.label: Stage
stageCards.summary: Restricted exports remain internally visible bundles until a separate masked export is minted.

stageCards.accessibleLabel: restricted export bundle follows audit and replay rules
stageCards.label: Scan
stageCards.summary: Restricted exports follow replay-safe evidence rules and never collapse into customer-safe handles.

stageCards.accessibleLabel: restricted export quarantine blocks any outward delivery
stageCards.label: Quarantine
stageCards.summary: A restricted bundle can still be quarantined, which revokes even operator-step-up delivery.

stageCards.accessibleLabel: restricted export published under audit and visibility partition
stageCards.label: Publish
stageCards.summary: Publication preserves audit and visibility partitioning instead of sharing a raw storage path.

stageCards.accessibleLabel: restricted export requires masked derivative before customer sharing
stageCards.label: Deliver
stageCards.summary: A masked export is still required before the restricted bundle can become customer-safe.

stageCards.accessibleLabel: restricted export retained as regulated record
stageCards.label: Retain / Erase
stageCards.summary: Restricted export retention stays governed like other regulated evidence-bearing artifacts.
